excerpt: This tutorial teaches you how to create and run one small task in HumanLayer. You will use the macOS app and Claude Code.
This tutorial teaches you how to run one task on a remote machine. You will control the task from app.humanlayer.com on a machine or phone.
Connect Jira Cloud so HumanLayer can create tasks from Jira tickets and keep ticket-driven agent work connected to its source.
Connect Slack to send HumanLayer task artifact updates into the channels where your team already works.
A HumanLayer task gives one piece of work: A group of related sessions, A shared set of task files, One place for comments and review, A history that can continue across agents and workstations
Use the shortest path that controls the main risk. A clear and small change can use Oneshot. A change with unclear behavior or code shape needs more review before implementation.
The host can be a cloud VM, workstation, or private-network machine. Select a host that can access the code, tools, credentials, and private services that the agent needs.
Use `.humanlayer/workspace.json` for shared repository or team configuration. Use `.humanlayer/workspace.local.json` for optional user or machine overrides.
HumanLayer registers these RPI sub-agents for Claude Code sessions
Select **Oneshot**, **RPI**, **PRD-Oriented**, or **Freeform**.
Configure a multi-repository workspace with this repository, ../api, and ../web. Make ../web the primary repository. Ask me before you choose setup commands or local files to copy.
Use `humanlayer automation run` to run one Cloud-visible coding session from any automation environment — a CI job, a cron machine, or a script on a server.
Use a launch token for one non-interactive command. Examples include a shell without an interactive PTY and a one-time remote bootstrap script.
This guide shows you how to install, authenticate, select, and check Codex for HumanLayer sessions.
HumanLayer sessions can run Claude through Amazon Bedrock instead of the Anthropic API.
Connect GitHub to create HumanLayer tasks from issues and link task artifacts back to the source issue.
Connect Linear so HumanLayer can create tasks from Linear issues, sync issue status, and link HumanLayer artifacts back to the source issue.
Live multiplayer response drafts — Write prompts together with shared text, named cursors, presence, read-only viewing, and draft recovery.
Draft PR creation — Ask the session agent to open a draft pull request from the GitHub tab or diff view.
Advanced Metrics for all paid plans — View usage, cost, and productivity metrics, with optional access for every organization member.
Keyboard navigation for changed files — Move through the PR changes tree with J/K, N/P, G shortcuts, and Enter.
Image paste in new tasks — Paste images straight into the new task composer as attachments.
